correctness.rationale: The frozen formula is mathematically correct: write A×=k××(1+m). The p^s-th power image of 1+m has exactly q^{r_s} elements because distinct surviving basis monomials remain distinct after multiplication of their exponent vectors by p^s, and field Frobenius permutes their coefficients. For a finite abelian p-group the second difference of the base-p logarithms of successive power-image sizes is the multiplicity of C_{p^s}. For a box, the surviving coordinate counts are ceil(a_i/p^s), with one removed for the constant. The repair drops classification as a finding and uses a direct proof for the surviving pair. In both boxes 2≤a≤p<b≤2p for all odd p, including p=3. Hence the p-power image of principal units is exactly 1+ky^p, of order p^f, and its p-power map is trivial. Each group has order p^{f(2p(p−1)−1)}; since there are f factors of order p², the rest are f(2p(p−1)−3) factors of order p. Scalar units are cyclic of order p^f−1. The two ordered exponent pairs have the same product 2p(p−1), different sums, and maximal ideals generated modulo their squares by x,y. The socle is spanned by the unique top monomial and the Loewy length is a+b−1, even for p=3. The powers of the two variables are a regular sequence. Neither direct computation requires extrapolation from the finite scripts. The repaired RESULT gives the exact fixed hypotheses and proof, and the reproduced finite examples described in VERIFICATION.md are not used as a proof.
